scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.board.json && tsc -p tsconfig.native.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:board && node scripts/build-board-development.mjs && playwright test
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:board && node scripts/desktop.mjs build
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && node scripts/desktop.mjs open
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && node scripts/desktop.mjs package
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:desktop && node scripts/desktop.mjs smoke
